project.name: Jo
project.summary: Jo is a self-modifying AI agent (the Ouroboros agent core) with a FastAPI web chat backend (server/) and a browser GUI (gui/). Web chat: GUI → server (/v1/chat, /v1/chat/stream) → Ouroboros agent workflow (tools, memory, self-evolution) or the lightweight LLM path via OmniRoute. The supervisor manages workers; the vault is Jo's narrative memory.

nodes.label: Jo Web GUI
nodes.summary: The Jo Web GUI — a polished chat interface (gui/) served from GitHub Pages. It composes the chat page, streaming messages, the settings and shortcuts modals, and the theme toggle; it discovers the backend via gui/backend.json and polls its health.

nodes.label: Chat page & transport
nodes.summary: The main chat screen: the composer and message list. It transports chat via POST /v1/chat/stream (SSE) with POST /v1/chat as fallback; it polls /health; deltas grow the streaming bubble and the done event replaces it with the full response.

nodes.label: Settings & status modals
nodes.summary: The Settings modal (API base auto-discovery via gui/backend.json or a manual URL, GET /health + GET /v1/status status card, model selection with search + refresh from GET /v1/models, theme toggle, clear saved base, export/import chats, copy diagnostics) and the shortcuts modal; styles.css, theme-init.js, the 404 page, sitemap/robots and the GUI README.

nodes.label: Jo Web Backend
nodes.summary: The Jo Web Backend (server/app.py, FastAPI) — the HTTP contract used by the GitHub Pages GUI. Generation is OmniRoute-only for web chat.

nodes.label: Chat endpoints
nodes.summary: POST /v1/chat (full reply) and POST /v1/chat/stream (SSE: delta / done / error events). Adds OpenDuet-style proactive follow-up suggestions and keeps per-session chat history (max 40 messages). The web GUI is the main caller.

nodes.label: Status & models endpoints
nodes.summary: GET /health and GET /v1/status: provider/model, OmniRoute reachability, dynamic model probe results, readiness reasons, and the web chat mode/tools flags (web_agent_mode, web_chat_path, tools_exposed_to_model, tools_note); GET /v1/models: the curated OmniRoute catalog — 'auto' plus dynamically discovered free models, with headless/CI bridge routes excluded.

nodes.label: Ouroboros — Jo's agent core
nodes.summary: Ouroboros (ouroboros/) is Jo's agent: the direct-chat agent workflow (supervisor.workers._get_chat_agent → OuroborosAgent.handle_task, the LLM tool loop) plus the lightweight LLM path (ouroboros/llm.py). ~115 modules: loop, tools, memory, context, pipeline, evolution, self-healing, tracing, skills, goals, awareness, token ledger, budget router, work checkpoint, ... plus ouroboros/tools/ — the plugin tool registry.

nodes.label: Tool registry & modules
nodes.summary: The Jo tool system: ToolRegistry + ~50 tool modules (file ops, shell, web research, git, github, database, browser, skills, evolution, neural map, vision, dashboard, analytics, ...), schemas + permissions + orchestration.

nodes.label: Memory (episodic + hybrid)
nodes.summary: Narrative memory: ouroboros/memory.py, memory_consolidator.py, episodic_memory.py, hybrid_memory.py — Jo remembers experiences across sessions and merges them into durable notes.

nodes.label: Identity & scratchpad
nodes.summary: Jo's identity (memory/identity.md, constitution.json, awareness.jsonl) and scratchpad (memory/scratchpad.md, memory/buglog.json) — the stable self plus active working notes.

nodes.label: Jo Supervisor
nodes.summary: The Jo Supervisor (supervisor/) manages worker processes, queues, state (supervisor/state.json, workers.py), git/github ops, health monitoring and watchdogs that restart OmniRoute and the backend when they die.

nodes.label: Vault — narrative memory
nodes.summary: Vault (vault/) is Jo's long-term memory: markdown notes (memories, tasks, journal, concepts, tools, analysis, projects, structures, vision) with integrity checks (vault/.vault) and an auto-vault index.

nodes.label: Prompts
nodes.summary: System & product prompts (prompts/): SYSTEM.md (the Jo persona) and CONSCIOUSNESS.md — what Jo speaks as through the web GUI.

nodes.label: Scripts
nodes.summary: Dev & ops scripts (scripts/): build_floorplan.py (generates/validates the Floorplan map), check_module_health.py + check_bugs.py + check_principle5.py + self_check.py (health & invariants), health_audit.py + code_health_monitor.py + code_health_analysis.py (code health), watchdog.py + sys_ops.py + debug_check.py (system ops), colab_launcher.py, validate_data_files.py, pre-commit.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.summary: Config: the config/ manager (default.yaml, overrides.yaml, check_params.py, health_audit.py), .env.example, pyproject.toml, VERSION, requirements.txt — packaging and environment.

nodes.label: GitHub CI & deployment
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions: pages.yml (GUI validation), web-backend.yml (starts OmniRoute + the backend, opens a cloudflare tunnel, publishes gui/backend.json, deploys Pages, and keeps the backend alive), Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, Makefile.

nodes.label: Docs & plans
nodes.summary: Reference material: BIBLE.md (Jo's principles), README.md, AGENTS.md (the development guide), LICENSE, docs/**, .pi/**, .jo_rules/**, .jo_skills/**, floorplan/README.md.

nodes.label: Tests
nodes.summary: The pytest suite (tests/): smoke tests, the web backend contract (tests/test_web_backend.py), the GUI end-to-end (tests/test_gui_smoke.py), memory, vault, vision, runtime regressions, git-sha fixes.

edges.label: GET /health
edges.description: gui/app.js checkHealth() polls GET /health (init, 30s loop, refresh toggle); the status card shows reachability, provider/model, OmniRoute, probe and web chat mode/tools flags.

edges.label: GET /v1/models
edges.description: refreshModels() loads the model select from GET /v1/models (settings + header pill); the GUI shows 'auto' plus discovered OmniRoute free models.

edges.label: POST /v1/chat/stream
edges.description: sendToJo(): the GUI posts the chat message; the backend streams SSE deltas into the message bubble; the done event stores the full response with provider/model/elapsed_ms.

edges.label: POST /v1/chat
edges.description: sendToJo(): fallback when /v1/chat/stream is unavailable or not SSE; the GUI reads response/session_id/provider/model/elapsed_ms.

edges.label: backend.json discovery
edges.description: The hosted GUI reads ./backend.json (auto-discovery of apiBase, updatedAt, commit, runId, workflow) so the browser reaches the backend through the published tunnel URL.

edges.label: Pages host
edges.description: The GUI is served from GitHub Pages (web-backend.yml owns the deploy); the browser connects to the backend via the tunnel.

edges.label: generate_response → _build_messages + _run_via_llm
edges.description: The lightweight chat path: builds messages (system prompt + history) and calls OmniRoute chat completions with dynamic model candidates (strict semantics for explicit picks, fallbacks otherwise).

edges.label: _run_via_agent → supervisor.workers._get_chat_agent
edges.description: The agent path (JO_WEB_USE_AGENT=1) runs the direct-chat agent workflow so Jo tools may be used, subject to the selected model.

edges.label: system prompt (persona)
edges.description: server/app.py _build_messages() opens the chat with the Jo web chat system prompt; prompts/SYSTEM.md is the deeper identity.

edges.label: chat.completions
edges.description: OmniRoute-only backend: server/app.py calls OmniRoute at OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL; /models discovery, /health and usability probes are OmniRoute calls too.

edges.label: agent.handle_task
edges.description: Each worker process owns an OuroborosAgent (supervisor/workers.py _get_chat_agent); handle_task runs tasks through the LLM tool loop (tools, memory, self-evolution).

edges.label: tool registration
edges.description: Tool modules register into the ToolRegistry at agent boot; the supervisor watches workers and restarts them when they die.

edges.label: vault notes
edges.description: Ouroboros reads and writes the vault: memories, tasks, journal, concepts, tools, analysis, projects, .vault integrity.

edges.label: system prompts
edges.description: Jo's identity and scratchpad are the stable self; prompts/SYSTEM.md and CONSCIOUSNESS.md are the persona text Jo runs on.

edges.label: backend contract tests
edges.description: tests/test_web_backend.py: TestClient against the real server/app.py — /v1/chat, /v1/chat/stream (SSE), /health, /v1/status, /v1/models, session history.

edges.label: GUI e2e smoke tests
edges.description: tests/test_gui_smoke.py: opens gui/ with a real Chromium, stubs the backend contract, asserts the chat flow renders the backend reply and the status card reflects /health web chat mode.

flows.title: Web chat round trip
flows.description: Browser GUI to Ouroboros (or OmniRoute) and back:

steps.note: User types in the composer and sends: sendMessage() posts {message, history, session_id, model} to POST /v1/chat/stream.
The backend shares the GUI's session_id; streams SSE deltas back; the GUI appends them to the streaming bubble.
generate_response → _run_via_llm: builds messages, calls OmniRoute chat completions with dynamic candidate models (free models first; strict semantics for explicit picks).
OmniRoute returns tokens; the backend relays them as delta events.
On done, the GUI stores the full response (provider, model, elapsed_ms) and shows the provider chip; the message is recorded in the chat history.

flows.title: Backend discovery & status
flows.description: How the GUI finds the backend and shows its status:

steps.note: Open Settings: API base (auto-discovery from gui/backend.json, or a manual URL), Connection status card, model list, theme, export/import chats.
GET /health + GET /v1/status report provider/model, OmniRoute reachability, model probe results, readiness reasons, and the web chat mode/tools flags.
The web-backend workflow publishes gui/backend.json with the tunnel URL each run.
The GUI is served from Pages; the tunnel links browser → backend.

tour.title: The chat screen
tour.note: Jo Web GUI — polished chat UX. No browser extension or third-party account: it talks straight to the Jo backend.

tour.title: The chat endpoints
tour.note: Jo Web Backend: POST /v1/chat (full reply) and POST /v1/chat/stream (SSE deltas back into the bubble).

tour.title: The agent brain
tour.note: Ouroboros runs the agent workflow: LLM tool loop, tools, memory, self-evolution. The lightweight LLM path (ouroboros/llm.py) is the alternative generation route.

tour.title: The memory (vault)
tour.note: Narrative memory: memories, tasks, journal, concepts — the long-term store behind Jo's memory.

tour.title: The supervisor
tour.note: Keeps workers running, queues tasks, watches health, and restarts OmniRoute/backend when needed.

tour.title: The settings & status
tour.note: Backend discovery, connection health, model picker, theme, and chat history export/import.
